get.description: Returns a list of comments associated with the project. Can be filtered by task_item_id and/or created_by_id.

parameters.description: Filter by task_item_id to return comments for only that task_item

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
Serialization view for each comment. Defaults to **`normal`** when omitted.

- **`compact`** — core fields including `task_item_id` (no nested `created_by` / attachments metadata).
- **`normal`** — includes `created_by` and attachments (default).
- **`extended`** — includes nested `task_item` (compact); omits `task_item_id`.
